description: CRITICAL MACRO AUTOMATION BUG FIXES: Resolved 4 critical macro automation issues - (1) Fixed Step 3 stalling by using contextRef for fresh state access instead of stale closure state, (2) Resolved Stop button blocked by implementing accessible UI overlay with pointer-events patterns, (3) Added completion state reset for proper re-run functionality, (4) Enhanced macro state debugging with comprehensive logging.
